name: React Bits
summary: GitBook of React patterns, techniques, tips and anti-patterns, each explained with code.
description: A compilation of React patterns, techniques, tips and anti-patterns as short markdown chapters with code: conditionals in JSX, async setState, dependency injection, context wrappers, event handlers, flux, presentational vs container components, and more. Read online as a GitBook or from the GitHub repo; community translations exist in Chinese and Korean.
contains: 18 pattern chapters plus an anti-patterns section
short markdown chapters with JSX code
